summary.name: Elytra
summary.one_liner: Elytra is a private RSS reader for iPhone, iPad and Mac that follows blogs, news sites and YouTube channels in a clean, ad- and tracker-free reading view.
use_cases: Follow blogs and news sites in one place
Read articles without pop-ups or trackers
Track a topic across many sites with Smart Folders
Read on iPhone, iPad and Mac with synced position
summary.what_it_does: Elytra is a native RSS reader app for iPhone, iPad and Mac. It aggregates feeds from blogs, news sites and YouTube channels, and opens each article in a clean view with no pop-ups, cookie banners or autoplay. Users can choose typeface, size and spacing, and control when images load on slow or metered connections. Smart Folders collect articles matching a topic, name or word across all subscribed sites and can notify on new matches, and filters hide unwanted topics. The page says it removes tracking scripts before articles reach the device and loads images through proxy servers, and that YouTube videos play inside articles at up to 1080p.
notable: Smart Folders gather matching articles from all feeds and can alert on new ones
Removes trackers and loads images through proxy servers
YouTube channel feeds with videos playable inside articles up to 1080p
Supports iPhone Duo foldable cover screen
caveats: Free tier limited to 10 feeds; unlimited feeds require Elytra Pro subscription or lifetime purchase
Platforms listed are iPhone, iPad and Mac only; no web or Windows version named
